The '''H'ken asteroid belt''' was located in the [[H'ken system/Legends|H'ken system]]. It was twenty [[Kilometer/Legends|kilometers]] wide. Shortly after the [[Battle of Bilbringi (9 ABY)|Battle of Bilbringi]], a [[Squadron/Legends|squadron]] of [[New Republic/Legends|New Republic]] [[X-wing starfighter/Legends|X-wing starfighters]] were [[Battle of H'ken asteroid belt|attacked]] and destroyed in the belt by an [[Restored Empire|Imperial splinter faction]].
